name: Shy
author: Ayan De
description: Privacy shield: the screen blurs when you look away from it and clears when you look back, driven by the glanced daemon's head-pose stream. No screen capture, no input grabbing, fails open.

barWidget.description: Toggle the look-away privacy shield, recentre it for your camera, snooze it, and see what the daemon sees.

schema.label: Comfort zone (degrees)
schema.description: Turn your head this far and nothing happens. Past it the veil starts to come in.

schema.label: Fully covered past (degrees)
schema.description: By this angle the whole screen is covered. Between the comfort zone and here the veil advances with your head.

schema.label: Veil follows your head
schema.description: On: the veil covers more of the screen the further you turn, and comes back as you turn back. Off: it is a switch with a dwell.

schema.label: Dwell before shielding (ms)
schema.description: How long you must stay turned away before the shield engages.

schema.label: Shield when nobody is there
schema.description: Walking away from the desk counts as looking away.

schema.label: Dwell before shielding an empty chair (ms)
Never shield over a fullscreen window
schema.description: Presentations, films, games: you will turn your head, and the screen should not care.

schema.label: Veil opacity
schema.description: How solid the veil is. With Hyprland blur enabled this can sit lower; without it, this alone hides the screen.

schema.label: Sweep in from the side you turned toward
schema.description: Turn left and the veil slides in from the right edge, then slides back out the same way. Off gives a plain fade.
